answer: Bonded vaults: before an identity grades or writes, it locks a bond that honest work slowly earns back. The protocol never trusts a fresh account unbacked - the vault stands behind every signature, and slashing takes from it directly, no court needed. A cedar of a record grows rings only through seasons of clean service; across the canyon of a new epoch, every pending grade still carries its bond at stake. Sybil farms face a wall of funded accounts: each fake needs real capital locked for weeks, returning nothing if a single jury flags it. Cheap identity dies when identity is collateral.
